Northrop Grumman is hiring an Associate Software Engineer for its Space sector in Azusa, California. The role supports software design, development, testing, integration, and debugging for mission and space-processing programs, with an emphasis on C++ object-oriented software.

You can ensure software standards are met
Understanding the importance of collaborating with a diverse team and across disciplines in an often-dynamic environment is a philosophy you share and demonstrate
Determining and developing technical solutions to complex problems is something you enjoy and even thrive on

Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills
